goal: 数字页从进入时就有可理解的主体，不让观众在说明和旁白已展开时等空白数值；保留对讲述重点的引导

baseline.impact: 近100% 页面 26.87秒开始，数字39秒附近才显示；观众听见比例后无法在主画面确认

production: video_autopilot.start_run with original flash_daily from daily batch 49f957e2bb5d45cfb42a2714e7513036 -> normal script/auto-finalization -> video_render -> G3/G2 -> download
automatic_inputs: Automatically generated narration, scene values, labels, notes and cue times
config: Existing actual production recipe, speed and Open Design/opencode fallback; isolate only state/storage; no assets or renderer injection for final workflow

candidates.name: baseline
candidates.benefit: 保留现状作为同稿原声控制

candidates.name: immediate
candidates.benefit: 数字与说明同时建立，直接消除主体空等
candidates.minimum: same original interval, only value entrance from scene start
candidates.stop: 若数字抢走理解上下文所需注意或与叙事冲突则放弃，不重写稿件适配

candidates.name: cue_emphasis
candidates.benefit: 主体从开始即可阅读，原旁白节点只加强颜色重点
candidates.minimum: same interval, readable initial value, original cue emphasis
candidates.stop: 若与 immediate 相比收益不明显或产生闪烁/注意干扰，采用更简单的 immediate

route_limit: 最多两轮无明确观看收益即停止该办法，不新增数字识别、素材系统或新的编排服务；不为个别数值/主题写例外

holdout.structure: Decisions API 小数价格与成本比例，另含正常价格/比较页边界

result.reviewed: sequence-01.jpg through sequence-07.jpg, entire 519.3–545.4s holdout at 1-second intervals
observations: At 520.3s price 0.10 is already readable with its unit; baseline still blank. Later both converge.
At 537.3–538.3s 20% completes the already-visible comparison label; no new comparison object or animation added.
Intervening concept scene remains visually unchanged; boundaries, captions, value layout and end state preserved.
result.decision: Holdout supports immediate value entrance without parameter changes or topic exceptions
result.limitations: Original audio retained and verified; visual sequence review, not continuous human listening or engagement measurement

success_evidence: 同稿原声视频中数字主体不再长时间空等，仍能跟随讲述
正常业务入口完整新成片包含未调试不同结构选题并自动用上
全片顺序检查、完整解码、同声对照、正常下载一致性
失败、取舍、人工介入和仍未解决问题保留
manual_interventions: 选择真实成片对照时间段；实验复制冻结渲染器，不改讲稿/分镜/音轨
